listing.name: Scrabble (1999) — scrabble-psx-pc-recomp (Bitsandbreakpoints)
listing.summary: The project describes a native playable board-and-word runtime with an enhanced frontend. Complete opponent and game-mode coverage have not been verified. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS00903 disc as BIN/CUE or CHD. An ISO omits the opening movies’ XA audio.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README’s scrabble-pc.zip setup, run scrabble.exe and choose your own image. The player reads assets from the disc. For a source build, game-code translation occurs during building.

warnings: The project describes a native playable board-and-word runtime with an enhanced frontend. Complete opponent and game-mode coverage have not been verified.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
